inputs.role: finite reduction dimensions and bounded perfect model
H0 vanishes and H1 torsion is the rational two-primary torsion group
full Selmer corank one from original RC assumption and companion rank zero

roles.derivation: Over Z2, the derived-dual universal coefficient sequence has only Hom and Ext1. H0=0 removes Hom in the H3 comparison, yielding H3=Ext1(H1,Z2). Ext1 has the same finite length as the torsion of H1. Tensor universal coefficients with Q2/Z2 identify the free H1 rank with the stated full Selmer corank, because the H2 torsion term is finite. Duality identifies the free ranks of H1 and H2. These are local deductions from the actual displayed inputs, not new claims attributed wholesale to Nekovar.
roles.boundary: Finite torsion and the Kummer cohomology identification remain incoming premises; no numerical rank theorem at an unknown base is imported.
